literal: With small defense, being of large space, that which destroys the zeal of the intense enemy is a fortress.
translation: A true fortress is one that requires only a small force to defend, offers ample space inside, and destroys the zeal of the attacking enemy.
modern: குறைந்த காவலுடன், பெரிய இடத்தைக் கொண்டு, வந்து தாக்கும் பகைவரின் ஊக்கத்தை அழிப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of an effective fortress (அரண்). First, it must require only a small guarding force (சிறுகாப்பு) to defend it, meaning its design makes it easy to secure. Second, it must have a large interior space (பேரிடத்தது) to accommodate people, provisions, and troops comfortably during a siege. Finally, its formidable nature must be such that it dampens and destroys the determination and zeal (ஊக்கம்) of even a powerful attacking enemy (உறுபகை). These physical and psychological advantages make a fortification truly secure.
